rationale: Builds on the recurrent-tail baseline without broad shape churn. This adds a compact late-phase training objective that overweights the last eval-stride tokens per sequence, aligning training a bit more closely to the final doc-isolated sliding-window score path while leaving exact final evaluation and quant-aware export intact. I also folded duplicated loss logic into a shared token-loss path to keep the script lean under the line cap.
title: Late Tail-Aligned Loss Blend
